docs.description: The toasts, oldest first: [{id, title?, text, variant?: info|ok|warn|danger, duration?}]. Server state: every morph brings the current list, and a toast the server drops is gone.
Corner of the viewport the stack is pinned to. "inline" puts it in the page flow instead (docs, demos, panels).
How many toasts are shown at once. Older ones wait and appear as newer ones go; only shown toasts count down.
Default time before a toast dismisses itself, in ms. 0 makes them sticky; a toast may carry its own duration.

events.name: sb-dismiss
events.description: A toast went away. detail: { id, reason: "user" | "timeout" }. It is already hidden locally; post a command if the server should drop it too.
